name: spec-pilot
description: Guide bounded spec-driven coding work, reuse project sources, and check document structure and evidence freshness.

interface.longDescription: Three local coding workflows: project orientation and planning, fresh-context design review, and bounded implementation with verification. Includes a standard-library Python checker for mapped documents and evidence hashes. Semantic judgments and project checks remain explicit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Spec Pilot to map this repository and identify the next bounded development step.
